SYMPTOM: '🔗 [KB] No responder found for open:options:completionHandler:' — deep links silently fail from keyboard extension
CAUSE: Keyboard extensions can't access UIApplication.shared at compile time; responder chain doesn't expose the 3-arg selector via perform(_:with:with:) because block arguments can't be passed that way
FIX:
```swift
private func openApp(path: String = "") {
    guard let url = URL(string: "whisnap-ios://\(path)") else { return }
    if let app = UIApplication.value(forKeyPath: "sharedApplication") as? UIApplication {
        app.open(url, options: [:], completionHandler: nil)
        return
    }
    showTemporaryError("Open Whisnap to continue")
}
```
PREVENT: Never use NSSelectorFromString("openURL:") (1-arg deprecated, force-returns false) or 3-arg via perform(_:with:with:) (can't pass block args). KVC is the standard keyboard extension workaround.
